responses.question: Which filter and selection controls must the new Visual Designer block support?
responses.answer: All operators, just like any rule conditions.

responses.question: Where should the block appear in the Rule Visual Designer, and how should it connect to the rule evaluation flow?
responses.answer: It appears before the terms in the Visual Designer, so filtering happens before term evaluation.

responses.question: Which UI states and viewport(s) must the acceptance screenshots cover, and what generated-code summary is required?
responses.answer: The implementation will be manually verified; capture the relevant Visual Designer states and summarize the generated code.
